AIDescription:
### General Description
Executes an advanced hunting query in Microsoft 365 Defender to retrieve data from specified tables using Kusto Query Language (KQL). This action allows users to perform complex searches across various Defender data schemas, supporting filtering by time range, selecting specific fields, and sorting results.

### Flow Description
1. Extracts configuration and action parameters.
2. Calculates the start and end timestamps based on the selected time frame.
3. Constructs a KQL query string using the provided table names, time filters, query clauses, fields, and sorting logic.
4. Sends a POST request to the Microsoft 365 Defender Advanced Hunting API (attempting Graph API first, then falling back to the legacy API) to execute the query.
5. Parses the API response and adds the retrieved data to the SOAR case as a data table and JSON result.

### Additional Notes
If "Custom" is selected for the time frame, the start time must be provided.

ParametersDescription:
| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Table Names | String | Yes | Specify what tables should be queried. |
| Query | String | No | Specify the query that needs to be executed. Use this parameter to provide \|where clauses. Note: you don’t need to provide time filter, limiting and sorting. |
| Time Frame | Dropdown | No | Specify a time frame for the results. If "Custom" is selected, you also need to provide "Start Time". |
| Start Time | String | No | Specify the start time for the results. This parameter is mandatory, if "Custom" is selected for the "Time Frame" parameter. Format: ISO 8601 |
| End Time | String | No | Specify the end time for the results. Format: ISO 8601. If nothing is provided and "Custom" is selected for the "Time Frame" parameter then this parameter will use current time. |
| Fields To Return | String | No | Specify what fields to return. |
| Sort Field | String | No | Specify what parameter should be used for sorting. |
| Sort Order | Dropdown | No | Specify the order of sorting. |
| Max Results To Return | Integer | No | Specify how many results to return. Default: 50. |
